tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search hotels in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Goa. For Dubai and Abu Dhabi, returns Fostay's hand-curated edit first (8 flagship stays with editorial verdicts), then catalog matches (~2,000 bookable hotels). For Goa, returns the best-reviewed hotels and resorts (hostels and homestays only when searched by na

tools.name: get_live_rates
tools.description: Live bookable room offers for one hotel and stay dates: total all-in price (AED), board (breakfast etc.), refundability and exact free-cancellation deadlines. For Goa, total_all_in counts GST, and any part the hotel collects at check-in is itemised separately (collected_by_hotel_at_checkin). The boo

tools.name: demand_calendar
tools.description: Fostay's editorial demand calendar (UAE only — Dubai and Abu Dhabi; Goa has no event calendar yet): the upcoming date windows where Dubai and Abu Dhabi hotels predictably spike or sell out (GITEX, F1, NYE, Eid, school breaks...), each with a suggested book-by deadline. Use it to warn users about exp

tools.name: when_to_go
tools.description: Prices upcoming weekends (Fri–Sun, 2 nights) to find the cheapest times to stay. Pass hotel_id for one hotel across ~8 weekends, or just a city to compare Fostay's curated stays (Dubai, Abu Dhabi) or top-rated Goa hotels across the next ~6 weekends. Cheapest options first.

tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Books everything except the payment: holds the chosen offer (real prebook — the price is locked while the hold lasts), registers the guest details, and returns a payment_url. The human opens that link, sees the exact stay summary, and pays in one step — the agent never handles card details. Confirm

tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Verify a completed booking: confirmation status, hotel confirmation code, stay and price. Requires the Fostay booking id AND the guest email it was booked under (both are in the guest's confirmation). Use after the human pays via a prepare_booking link.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Books everything except the payment: holds the chosen offer (real prebook — the price is locked while the hold lasts), registers the guest details, and returns …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_stays" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
